---
title: "RNA ATAC Linkage"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Purpose

Link gene expression with nearby accessible regions and store links in the multiome object.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Signac)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/multiome_wnn.qs"
output_object <- "path/to/multiome_rna_atac_links.qs"
results_dir <- "results/rna_atac_linkage"
figures_dir <- "figures/rna_atac_linkage"
rna_assay <- "RNA"
atac_assay <- "peaks"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
features_of_interest <- c("GENE1", "GENE2")
distance <- 500000
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
object <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(inherits(object, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(all(c(rna_assay, atac_assay) %in% Assays(object)))
stopifnot(all(c(sample_column, group_column) %in% colnames(object[[]])))
features_of_interest <- intersect(features_of_interest, rownames(object[[rna_assay]]))
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
readr::write_tsv(tibble::tibble(cells = ncol(object), features_requested = length(features_of_interest)), file.path(results_dir, "linkage_input_summary.tsv"))
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
DefaultAssay(object) <- atac_assay
object <- LinkPeaks(object = object, peak.assay = atac_assay, expression.assay = rna_assay, genes.use = features_of_interest, distance = distance)
links <- Links(object)
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
link_tbl <- as.data.frame(links)
readr::write_tsv(tibble::as_tibble(link_tbl), file.path(results_dir, "rna_atac_links.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "coverage_linked_features.pdf"), width = 9, height = 4)
if (length(features_of_interest) > 0) print(CoveragePlot(object, region = features_of_interest[1], features = features_of_interest[1], expression.assay = rna_assay))
dev.off()
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
object@misc$rna_atac_linkage <- list(features = features_of_interest, distance = distance, n_links = length(links))
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(tibble::as_tibble(link_tbl), file.path(results_dir, "linked_peaks.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-03-rna-atac-linkage-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, linked_features = length(features_of_interest))
```
